chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The hadd is not carried out upon the woman experiencing istiḥāḍah until the blood ceases from her.

key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah, irregular uterine bleeding

ai.seo_question: Is the hadd punishment carried out on a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah before her bleeding stops?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the prescribed hadd punishment is not to be implemented on a woman in a state of istiḥāḍah until her bleeding stops. It reflects consideration of bodily condition in the timing of judicial punishment.
